defs.def: one thing on a list of things to buy, do, talk about, etc. 项目

ex.s: Furniture Restoration: take an active role in transforming reclaimed furniture and materials into useful items, giving them a new life;
ex.t: 创意工作坊：学习旧家具的基本维修和艺术改造，同时与 fellow 志愿者分享知识和想法，

ex.s: For two weeks in March, Greenwich Village’s Blue Hill restaurant was renamed wastED, and served items like fried skate cartilage, a juice pulp burger, and a dumpster diver’s vegetable salad.
ex.t: 三月的头两周，格林尼治村的蓝山餐厅改名为wastED，供应诸如炸鳐鱼软骨、果汁渣汉堡和垃圾箱潜水者蔬菜沙拉之类的菜品。

ex.s: It should be noted that none of the items on wastED’s menu was technically made from garbage.
ex.t: 值得注意的是，wastED菜单上的所有菜品严格来说都不是用垃圾制作的。

ex.s: Borrowed items are subject to recall by the lending library.
ex.t: 成为一名成功的画家需要果断。

ex.s: Consumers prefer money off individual items.
ex.t: 消费者更喜欢单个商品打折。

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日，那天我们为收集物资付出的所有努力终于汇聚在一起。当我看到我们收集到的各种物资时，我突然意识到，那天我们要制作的每一个套装最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中。在过去的四个月里，我从未想象过项目完成后自己会有怎样的感受。在制作这些套装的过程中，我意识到自己已经忽略了它背后的真正意义——我只顾着把它当成又一个学校项目，而且是我想要拿高分的一个。当这些套装制作完成、准备送往海外时，那种温暖的感觉我将永远铭记。

ex.s: Lost items become the property of transport for London.
ex.t: 百分之二十的失物在三个月内被认领。

ex.s: Twenty percent of the lost items are claimed in three months’ time.
ex.t: 百分之二十的遗失物品在三个月内被认领。

ex.s: The more formal economics term for these two items is budget set.
ex.t: 这两个项目的更正式的经济学术语是预算集。

defs.def: a single article or object 一件商品（或物品）

ex.s: Current students, teachers (including retired) and staff can request items through ILL.
ex.t: 在校学生、教师（含退休）和员工可通过ILL申请物品。

ex.s: However, obtaining items that are rare, recently published or in high demand may take longer.
ex.t: 然而，获取稀有、新出版或需求量大的物品可能需要更长时间。

ex.s: Call Lost Property on 13 16 17 during business hours for items lost on Queensland Rail services.
ex.t: 如在昆士兰铁路服务中遗失物品，请在营业时间内拨打失物招领处电话13 16 17。

ex.s: According to Paragraph 3, what items may be checked out from a public library? （    ）
ex.t: 根据第3段，哪些物品可以从公共图书馆借出？（    ）

ex.s: Lost items are taken good care of by Cowan's team.
ex.t: 丢失的物品受到考恩团队的妥善保管。

ex.s: Almost all of the lost items were returned to their owners.
ex.t: 几乎所有丢失的物品都归还给了它们的主人。

ex.s: For a physical item, you will be notified by email when it arrives.
ex.t: 对于实体物品，到达时你会收到电子邮件通知。

ex.s: Items are picked up at one of our libraries — the one you selected in the ILL Request Form.
ex.t: 物品在我们的一家图书馆取——即你在馆际互借申请表上选择的那家。

ex.s: （3）Among the items provided by the school for a visual presentation are     ．
ex.t: （3）学校为视觉呈现提供的物品包括     。

ex.s: These items helped to make the lives of poor and homeless people a little bit easier.
ex.t: 这些物品帮助穷人和无家可归者的生活变得稍微容易一些。

ex.s: Do research if necessary into how each item can be used for survival.
ex.t: 如有必要，研究每件物品如何用于生存。

ex.s: You may include: • a general introduction to the island • survival tips with items from the ship and natural resources on the island 2 Look for or create visuals to illustrate your survival guide.
ex.t: 你可以包括：• 对岛屿的总体介绍 • 利用船上的物品和岛上的自然资源提供生存技巧 2 寻找或创建图像来说明你的生存指南。

ex.s: What’s more, sharing encourages us to reuse items, thereby cutting down on waste.
ex.t: 而且，共享鼓励我们重复使用物品，从而减少浪费。

ex.s: A vacuum cleaner also comes in handy for fetching items that are floating around out-of-reach!
ex.t: 吸尘器也可以用来取漂浮在够不着的地方的物品！
